properties.name: nodes
properties.description:
The organization tree. Accepts an `OrgChartNode[]` (property) or a JSON
string (attribute). Multiple roots are supported (rendered side by side).

properties.name: selectionMode
properties.description:
Selection behaviour:
  - `'none'`     — nodes are not selectable (default).
  - `'single'`   — one node at a time.
  - `'multiple'` — any number of nodes.

properties.name: selectedIds
properties.description: Selected node ids (controlled + initial). Kept in sync as the user selects.

properties.name: collapsible
properties.description: Show expand/collapse togglers on nodes that have children.

properties.name: orientation
properties.description:
Layout direction of the tree:
  - `'vertical'`   — top-down (default).
  - `'horizontal'` — left-to-right; RTL mirrors it right-to-left.

Only the visual layout changes — the tree's ARIA semantics and keyboard
model (Arrow Left/Right = collapse/expand, Up/Down = move) are unchanged.

properties.name: expandLabel
properties.description: Toggler accessible label when a node is collapsed (localisable).

properties.name: collapseLabel
properties.description: Toggler accessible label when a node is expanded (localisable).

properties.name: density
properties.description:
Local density rung. Drives the same `--md-sys-density-scale` signal that a
global `data-density` ancestor sets, so a local value simply overrides the
inherited one. 0 = default, -4 = ultra-compact.

cssParts.name: branch
cssParts.description: A role="treeitem" list item (the node and its subtree)

cssParts.name: branch-on-path
cssParts.description: A branch on the path from a selection up to its root

name: Organization Chart
description: A tree of avatar cards joined by connectors. Renders a hierarchy — reporting lines, categories, taxonomies — with collapsible branches, optional selection and the full WAI-ARIA tree keyboard model.

notes: Dedicated native organization chart: all nine properties (nodes as an array, an object or a JSON string; selection none/single/multiple with selectedIds; collapsible; vertical and horizontal orientation; label, expandLabel, collapseLabel; density 0…−4), mdSelectionChange { node, selectedIds } and mdNodeToggle { node, expanded } with the full node object, the empty slot (default "No data" status) and the fifteen --md-org-chart-* appearance hooks.

Layout is the source's CSS model: centred flex tree in a scrolling viewport (RTL starts at the right edge), pseudo-element connectors with 12px elbows, the selection trail up to the root (also from folded-away selections), Roboto card text measured exactly, md-avatar (accent ring) and md-icon-button togglers in md-tooltip hung on the card edge; RTL mirrors both orientations.

Interaction as in the source: roving tree-item tab stop (first root, then the last focused), WAI-ARIA tree keys (ArrowUp/Down, forward/backward with RTL swap in both orientations, Home/End, Enter/Space select or toggle), a press focuses the item and a click selects it, a toggler click folds and focuses its row; folding or new data hands focus to the visible owner.

Motion: border, selection ring, hover elevation and state layer transition 300 ms emphasized (pseudo-class changes start at once, state changes a frame later like the source's async render); md-org-chart-grow on every inserted group and on keyframe changes; a 100 ms z-index hold; reduced motion removes them (md-ripple still runs).
::part() styling has no native equivalent yet: the parts are listed as unsupported visual parts (decision recorded in md-organization-chart-source-review.md).
